item.description: When Coastal Engineering Meets Community Stewardship, Water Restoration Follows A major transformation is taking place along the shores of the Hillsmere community in Annapolis, one that blends cutting-edge coastal engineering with grassroots community stewardship. item.title: Sailing and Sailmaking to the Top
item.description: Q&A With Andrew Scott, President of Quantum Sails and Annapolis Sailor In January, Annapolis native Andrew Scott was named president of Quantum Sails. With more than 70 lofts around the world and four state-of-the-art production centers, Quantum is the world’s second largest sailmaker. We caught up with Andrew at Quantum’s Eastport loft last month to learn more about growing up in a sail loft, high-end racing campaigns, and weeknight racing fun at home in Annapolis: Andrew on main, facing camera

item.title: A Spring Commissioning Primer for Sailboat Owners
item.description: Prepping Your Sailboat for Spring Sailing Season It’s time to get your baby out of mothballs. item.title: Sailing and Climbing in Extreme Environments - Gary Jobson in Antarctica
item.description: Annapolis Film Festival Showcases Gary Jobson’s 1995 Antarctic Expedition Film Did you know that Annapolis sailor and renowned sailing commentator Gary Jobson led an expedition to the Antarctic Peninsula aboard a 54-foot steel-hulled sloop Pelagic for 35 days in 1995? On Saturday, March 28, at the Annapolis Film Festival, viewers may see the footage of “Sail to Antarctica” with their own eyes as well attend a Q&A with Jobson afterward.
